## Change / 修改

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. / 说明具体问题及修改后的行为。

## Validation / 验证

- [ ] Relevant offline tests pass; browser checks, if any, are reported separately. / 相关离线测试通过；网页验收另列。
- [ ] English and Chinese instructions remain equivalent. / 中英文说明保持等价。
- [ ] Release checks pass and no personal or runtime data is included. / 发布检查通过，未带入个人或运行资料。
- [ ] The workflow still stops at a draft. / 流程仍止于草稿。
